collection.title: Audi RS6 Saloon 2002 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 2002 to 2004 version of an Audi RS6 Saloon requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
